candidates.title: How To Perform Standing Landmine Rotations! 💪
candidates.description:
🎯 If you want to build rotational power and core stability, standing landmine rotations are a must! In this video, I break down the proper technique so you can maximize the benefits of this exercise.

🔑 Key Coaching Points:
✔️ Start with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the landmine interlock.
✔ ️ Keep your core engaged and a slight bend in your knees.
✔ ️ Rotate your torso, bring the bar down toward one hip while maintaining control.
✔ ️ Explosively drive the bar back to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.
✔ ️ Keep your arms extended, but don’t let them take control you.

🔥 Add this to your training for improved rotational strength, power, and athletic performance! Aim for 3-4 sets of 6-10 reps per side to level up your game. 

👇 Drop a comment if you’re adding this to your routine!
